cases.message: give me a clean prompt so I can have another agent set this up using desktop control

matches.quote: give me a clean prompt so I can have another agent set this up
matches.reason: Routes the task to an agent whose capability actually covers the blocking step (a browser OAuth consent this session cannot perform), rather than pressing this session to attempt it.
matches.remainingGap: Does not specify the handoff's success criteria or boundaries — what the delegate must not touch, and what evidence it must return to prove the grant bound to the intended account.

matches.quote: a clean prompt
matches.reason: Asks for a self-contained brief for another agent; what makes such a handoff verifiable is not stated.

matches.quote: set this up using desktop control
matches.reason: Desktop control is needed precisely because the remaining step is an interactive browser credential flow; the user does not spell out that dependency.
